title: From Tokenmaxxing to Trusted Throughput — Mingsheng Hong, Ironclad
talk_summary: Ironclad argues teams should optimize token ROI and trusted throughput rather than minimize token spend, measuring both cost and shipped value. It identifies code review and CI as new bottlenecks after AI makes PR generation abundant, and recommends AI first-pass review, CI flakiness metrics, guardrails, prompt caching, context pruning, and loop limits.

takeaways.technique: Usage dashboard as smoke detector, not leaderboard
takeaways.what_they_do: Aggregate token/cost data across coding tools per team and individual, review for adoption gaps and sudden bursts, compare contextually, and feed learnings into best practices rather than rank people.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we don't want to create even indirect incentive to maximize the token usage itself

takeaways.technique: AI first-pass review before human/strong-model escalation
takeaways.what_they_do: Use AI review as first defense for style and missing tests; route only subjective architecture/security judgment to human reviewers who retain accountability.
takeaways.evidence_quote: onboard AI tooling as the first level of defense they don't replace human reviewers

takeaways.technique: Instrument and fix CI flakiness/queue time
takeaways.what_they_do: Invest in developer experience to remove flaky tests and improve CI; measure ready-to-submit-to-merged time and retry count as red flags.
takeaways.evidence_quote: removing the flaky test improving the CI infrastructure

takeaways.what_they_do: Move from open PR count to merged PR count, then tag each merged PR with an AI-assigned t-shirt complexity score to approximate value.
takeaways.evidence_quote: tagging each merged PR with some sort of complexity score

takeaways.technique: Stable prompt prefix for caching plus context compaction
takeaways.what_they_do: Structure prompts with fixed system prompt at top and variable content at bottom to exploit provider prompt caching; summarize/compact long contexts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: put the system prompt that's fixed at the top and the varying content at the bottom

takeaways.technique: Hard cap on agentic loop steps
takeaways.what_they_do: When agents auto-fix and retry tests, set a limit on loop steps so runaway loops don't waste tokens.
takeaways.evidence_quote: put a limit on the number of loop steps
